routes.title: The Shining Sword Is With Us

rows.en: Colonel, what the hell is that damn huge Metal Armor they've hauled into the hangar?
rows.notes: Min asks Gon Jem about the newly delivered machine.

rows.en: Oh... So you saw it too. That's my trump card, Gilgazamune.
I've heard rumors... That they're testing a top-secret prototype somewhere in Asia...
Just as you figured. That Gilgazamune is a state-of-the-art machine they're still testing.
I twisted the lab boys' arms and made them bring it here.
That's amazing, Colonel! With that thing, the Dragonars won't stand a chance!
It's for me to pilot, after all. I even had them add a special steel sword to match that body.
rows.notes: Steel sword renders physical blade, distinct from beam weapons.

rows.en: I-I wanna pilot that thing too!
Forget it, Gol. There's no way you could handle that thing.
What's wrong, Zin? You look so serious...
Colonel... Have you heard about the system installed in it, too...?
You mean the Biofeedback System? Of course I have.
uncertain: Biofeedback System is not an exact glossary entry; ordinary technical rendering reported to orchestrator.

rows.en: Bio... Bio... What's that?
rows.notes: Gol stumbles over the unfamiliar technical name.

rows.en: The Biofeedback System... I've only heard rumors myself, but...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing clause; row 15 continues the explanation.
uncertain: Retained unfinished clause continued in row 15.
Biofeedback System is absent as exact glossary entry.

rows.en: Apparently, it uses the pilot's brainwaves to help control the machine.
That's right. They say it makes the machine react and respond to your movements a hell of a lot faster.
But, Colonel... They're still testing it, aren't they...? Is it safe?
Min... Don't you start talking like those scrawny little eggheads at the lab, too.
rows.notes: Preserves the derisive description of the lab staff.

rows.en: Sure, the system's still experimental, and they've barely even tested it in actual combat.
But I need overwhelming power to crush the Dragonars and #部隊名...!
rows.notes: Gon Jem needs the power; the squad placeholder is the enemy target.

rows.en: You've all heard what's happening back home on the Moon, haven't you?
Yeah... Those Federation bastards are apparently mounting a massive counteroffensive against the Moon.
Frankly, I couldn't care less about the homeland, but I can't afford to lose my own war...!
Those Dragonar brats and the #部隊名 lot have made me eat dirt time and again...
rows.notes: Eat dirt renders repeated humiliation, not literal scalding.

rows.en: My pride won't let me keep on losing!!
But...
rows.notes: Retained interrupted objection.
uncertain: Retained interrupted objection.

rows.en: Drop it, Min. You know as well as I do that once the Colonel makes up his mind, nothing can budge him.
T-the Colonel can do it... He can handle any machine!
...I know how skilled the Colonel is, and how much guts he's got...
But this time, I just can't bring myself to feel good about it...
What's gotten into you? This isn't like you at all.
It's just that something's got me really worried...
Women's intuition, huh?
rows.notes: Ignored the documented stray closing quote and break.

rows.en: My intuition has never been wrong!!
Thanks, Min. But I won't be defeated...! I'll crush them, no matter what!!
But it'll take a little time to get Gilgazamune adjusted. So...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing setup answered by Ganan in 38.
uncertain: Retained deliberate trailing setup.

rows.en: I get it, Colonel. Gol and I will keep #部隊名 occupied.
I'm counting on you, Ganan, Gol. But don't get carried away and wipe them out.
rows.notes: Gon Jem asks Ganan and Gol to stall the enemy, not to count on him.

rows.en: They're my prey, after all.
I can't promise you that. Gol and I both have scores to settle with them, you know.
I-I wanna smash them too!
Gwahahaha! That's what I like to hear from you boys!
I'm counting on you, Ganan, Gol... Please finish them off before the Colonel uses that thing, if you can...
rows.notes: Min privately asks Ganan and Gol to kill the enemy before Gon Jem uses Gilgazamune.

rows.en: Otherwise... I've got a really bad feeling about this...
rows.notes: Continuation of private request in 44; bad feeling is Min's.

rows.en: ...Next, I'll compare this set of data...
rows.notes: Linda talks through her data analysis before noticing Kaine.
uncertain: Retained audible unfinished self-directed analysis.

rows.en: What are you doing, Linda?
Oh... Kaine... I'm comparing your combat capabilities with Gon Jem's.
rows.notes: Linda compares Kaine and Gon Jem, not their factions.

rows.en: Huh... So, what's the verdict?
...Just as I thought, you can't beat Gon Jem one-on-one... No matter what the conditions are...
rows.notes: The subject is Kaine, listener of Linda's assessment.

rows.en: I see... So that really was a dream of things to come...
rows.notes: Kaine refers to his nightmares explained in 53; premonition is his fearful reading.

rows.en: Huh...?
I can't tell her... That I haven't been getting enough sleep because I keep having nightmares of Gon Jem beating me...
rows.notes: Kaine cannot tell Linda the cause of his sleep deprivation.

rows.en: I-it's nothing! ...Well then, I'm off for another spirited day of training!
rows.notes: Playfully formal departure for training follows his denial.

rows.en: Don't push yourself too hard, Kaine... You haven't been sleeping much lately, have you...?
Huh... How did you know...?
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing surprise question.
uncertain: Retained deliberate trailing question.

rows.en: I can tell just by watching you... At least that much...
rows.notes: Linda can tell Kaine's condition by observing him.

rows.en: I'm fine! Operation Moonraker on the Moon is in its final stages, and Giganos has a fire under its ass!
rows.notes: Retains the source's crude urgency metaphor.
uncertain: Operation Moonraker is absent as exact glossary entry; spelling reported to orchestrator.

rows.en: Their troops on Earth must be panicking by now, too.
Yes... That's why... Gon Jem might challenge you to a final showdown, too...
Don't worry! Yours truly, Kaine Wakaba, has always found a way to pull through!
I'll find a way this time, too... You can count on it.
Kaine...
uncertain: Retained name-only emotional address.

rows.en: So there's no need for you to look at me like that...!
rows.notes: Private appeal to Linda, following her worried address in 63.

rows.en: You bastard! Take that!!
rows.notes: Kaine addresses sparring opponent George; scene changes to practice.

rows.en: That won't do. A combination attack and a wild flurry of blows may look alike, but they're quite different.
rows.notes: George contrasts coordinated sword blows with uncontrolled attacks.

rows.en: And impatience leaves you open. This is the result...!
Whoa!!
Check... If this were a real battle, you would certainly be dead.
rows.notes: George uses chess-like check to mark the lethal opening.

rows.en: That makes 138 confirmed deaths since you started training.
rows.notes: Sai Saici sarcastically counts Kaine's simulated deaths.

rows.en: At this rate, won't you be an old man and die for real by the time you learn Predict?
rows.notes: Predict is the glossary term; neighboring 81-93 explain its swordsmanship meaning.
uncertain: Predict preserves glossary spelling but is also a natural swordsmanship concept in this scene.

rows.en: Shut up! I'll master this Predict thing before I hit 150!!
rows.notes: 150 is the mock-death tally, not days or training repetitions generally.
uncertain: Predict preserves glossary spelling for contextual swordsmanship.

rows.en: That's the spirit. Now, pick up your sword. We'll go again.
Yeah! Here I coooome!!
He sure doesn't get tired of this... It's been three days already.
rows.notes: Asuka comments on Kaine's training while speaking to Shinji.

rows.en: Yeah...
Why don't you get them to train you, too?
rows.notes: Asuka proposes that Shinji ask the martial artists to train him.

rows.en: N-no, I...
rows.notes: Retained trailing refusal, not omitted ordinary subject.
uncertain: Retained unfinished refusal.

rows.en: But can he really learn this "Predict" thing by doing that?
rows.notes: He refers to Kaine. Ayato answers in 80; Domon explains in 81 onward.
uncertain: Predict preserves glossary spelling for quoted swordsmanship term.

rows.en: Who knows... I have no idea about that...
rows.notes: Answers Megumi's question about learning Predict through sparring.

rows.en: The ultimate secret of the sword is Predict...
rows.notes: Deliberate martial maxim; canonical glossary ability name retained.

rows.en: Predict means dodging your opponent's sword tip by a hair... Attack and defense are like the two sides of a sheet of paper...
rows.notes: Explains the martial maxim to the watching group; preserves paper imagery.

rows.en: It certainly is a skill for real combat. Being able to see an opponent's attack coming completely changes how a battle plays out.
rows.notes: Responds to Domon's description; see means read an incoming attack.

rows.en: So Kaine's training with George to try to learn Predict...
rows.notes: Restores Kaine as the subject of the training.

rows.en: Hmm... Can he really manage it in another two or three days?
rows.notes: Asks whether Kaine can acquire the skill quickly.

rows.en: He can't.
rows.notes: Answers Megumi directly; restores Kaine as subject.

rows.en: Huh?
rows.notes: Surprised interjection.

rows.en: Well, of course he can't. This isn't a game. There's no way he could master it that easily.
rows.notes: Dismissive reply to the learning timetable.

rows.en: Then why is Kaine trying to learn Predict...?
rows.notes: Source trails into an implied question; English supplies its settled action.

rows.en: Predict means putting yourself within a hair of your opponent's blade... You can't do it with even the slightest fear...
rows.notes: Domon explains the danger and mental requirement.

rows.en: For that, you must have absolute confidence in your own swordsmanship...
rows.notes: Generic second person describes the skill requirement.

rows.en: Kaine has certainly fought his way through deadly battles in D-1...
rows.notes: Keeps source unit shorthand D-1.

rows.en: But the road to absolute confidence is endlessly long... He can't hope to reach it after only a few days of training...
rows.notes: Second clause explicitly restores Kaine; complete sentence ending retained.

rows.en: Then hurry up and tell him. Tell him he's wasting his time doing that.
rows.notes: Asuka tells Domon to inform Kaine; blunt force retained.

rows.en: Asuka... That's harsh...
rows.notes: Rebukes Asuka's dismissive phrasing.

rows.en: I don't think it's a complete waste... At the very least, I think practicing is better than not practicing...
rows.notes: Tentatively defends Kaine's practice.

rows.en: Honestly... Think about it. Kaine might see Gon Jem as a rival, but...
rows.notes: First omitted man is Kaine, established by training discussion; preserves row-boundary trail.

rows.en: That doesn't mean he has to play along with Gon Jem's favorite sword fights!
rows.notes: Second man in preceding exchange is Gon Jem; names him to avoid ambiguous repeated he.

rows.en: That's true... I think he'd have a chance if he kept his distance and turned it into a firefight.
rows.notes: He refers to Kaine; ranged combat is proposed as alternative.

rows.en: Could Kaine... really not have realized that...?
rows.notes: That refers to the ranged-combat alternative.

rows.en: He can't defeat that man, Gon Jem, by fighting that way...
rows.notes: He is Kaine; that way is fighting at range.

rows.en: And Kaine himself probably wouldn't want it settled that way.
rows.notes: Kaine's wish for a decisive confrontation is inferred by Domon, so probably retained.

rows.en: Huh...
rows.notes: Surprised response.

rows.en: Swordsmanship isn't the only thing he needs to learn. He needs the heart it takes to fight.
rows.notes: He remains Kaine; heart is fighting resolve rather than technical skill.

rows.en: Do you mean the Clear Mind Still Water state that Schwarz taught you?
rows.notes: Rain addresses Domon; canonical state name retained. Initial glossary gap resolved centrally against Akurasu Master_Characters_List and A_Portable/Pilot_Database: Schwarz Bruder, short Schwarz.

rows.en: Clear Mind Still Water... It's a little different from that.
rows.notes: Rejects equivalence to his own named state.

rows.en: Kaine isn't a martial artist... What he needs now is to fight desperately to stay alive...
rows.notes: Kaine needs survival resolve, not Domon's martial state.

rows.en: He must stop relying on others, overcome his fear, and hone the life force within him to its very limit.
rows.notes: Restores Kaine as subject; amae interpreted as reliance on rescue, clarified by George at 125-126.

rows.en: When he can do that, he'll be able to overcome the part of himself that cowers before Gon Jem.
rows.notes: Fear refers specifically to Kaine's fear of Gon Jem, confirmed by earlier nightmare scene.

rows.en: Is that why he's training with a sword?
rows.notes: Asks about Kaine's training rationale.

rows.en: Yes... I'm certain George and Sai Saici will awaken that spirit in him.
rows.notes: That spirit is Kaine's survival resolve.

rows.en: By the way, where are the people who'd usually love this sort of thing? I don't see them around.
rows.notes: Changes subject to the absent combat enthusiasts.

rows.en: You're right... Koji, Akira, and Allenby aren't here...
rows.notes: Names follow supplied glossary.

rows.en: Kaine inspired them to go off and do some training of their own.
rows.notes: They refers to the three named at 113; no gender inference needed.

rows.en: Then what does that make those of us still here...?
rows.notes: Comic trailing implication aimed at the idle observers.

rows.en: I-I don't need any special training at this point!!
rows.notes: Defensive stutter and boast retained.

rows.en: Hah...!
rows.notes: Sword-strike exertion.

rows.en: D-damn it!!
rows.notes: Frustration after another practice defeat.

rows.en: How many times has he died now?
rows.notes: He is Kaine; mock deaths in sparring.

rows.en: That's his 144th... Six more to go until the 150 he promised.
rows.notes: Replies to Tapp's count; Kaine's promise recalled from source neighbor72.

rows.en: One more time! I'll keep at it as many times as it takes!!
rows.notes: Kaine insists on repeated practice attempts.

rows.en: You should abandon that idea of having one more try.
rows.notes: Challenges Kaine's assumption that he can always retry.

rows.en: Huh...?
rows.notes: Ignored documented stray closing bracket and indent after source body.

rows.en: Kaine, in a real fight, it's over the first time you die. You know that, right?
rows.notes: Explains George's warning directly to Kaine.

rows.en: We're using real swords, but somewhere in your heart, you believe I won't actually take your life.
rows.notes: George identifies Kaine's reliance on his restraint.

rows.en: That's why you think you'll get another chance even if you fail.
rows.notes: Continues diagnosis of Kaine's safe practice mindset.

rows.en: With your lack of experience, you must push yourself right to the brink of life and death...
rows.notes: Speaks to Kaine after omitted owned silence at i06e2b127, examined in all-source.

rows.en: I admit you're working hard... But it's still impossible to master Predict in such a short time...
rows.notes: Concedes effort while rejecting short-term mastery.

rows.en: But... I've gotta do it... Otherwise, I'll... That bastard Gon Jem will...
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished fear of being killed; earlier nightmare and Linda's comparison identify referent.
uncertain: Preserves the source's deliberate unfinished consequence; Kaine cannot finish saying what Gon Jem will do to him.

rows.en: Kaine...
rows.notes: Concerned address to Kaine.

rows.en: Everyone, the enemy's approaching! It's the Gon Jem Squad!!
rows.notes: Allenby interrupts with enemy warning.

rows.en: Tch, the bastards are here!
rows.notes: Enemy squad is plural referent.

rows.en: They've got quite a force! Looks like they mean business this time!
rows.notes: Reports sizable attacking force; they refers to squad.

rows.en: Damn... Gon Jem wants to settle this here...! Let's go, Tapp, Light!!
rows.notes: Kaine rushes to deploy with friends.

rows.en: Wait, Kaine. You must not go.
rows.notes: George forbids immediate deployment.

rows.en: What the hell are you talking about?! Gon Jem's coming! He's sure to come after me!
rows.notes: Angry protest; Gon Jem is explicit pursuer.

rows.en: Are you going out there to die?
rows.notes: George challenges Kaine; reaction ! in omitted owned row139 examined.
Punctuation-only surprise used twice, at i024b:215 and :250.

rows.en: If you're going to die anyway, why not stake that life on your training with me?
rows.notes: Invites Kaine to risk his life in training rather than premature deployment.

rows.en: B-but...
rows.notes: Deliberately interrupted protest.

rows.en: Don't worry, Kaine. We'll hold them off until you've learned Predict.
rows.notes: Tapp and allies offer to buy Kaine time.

rows.en: But you only get one chance. Don't think there'll be a next time.
rows.notes: Reinforces life-or-death finality of next training attempt.

rows.en: You guys...
rows.notes: Emotional unfinished address to friends.

rows.en: Well, I'm counting on you to handle the rest, George.
rows.notes: Request goes from Sai Saici to George; brotherly address rendered by informal tone.

rows.en: Leave it to me. Though I can't guarantee Kaine will survive the next round...
rows.notes: George accepts Sai Saici's request and warns about next live-blade attempt.

rows.en: Hurry, Kaine!
rows.notes: Calls for fast completion of training.

rows.en: We'll be waiting for you!
rows.notes: Tapp tells Kaine his friends await him.

rows.en: Tapp, Light... Everyone...
rows.notes: Emotional address to departing friends.

rows.en: Have faith in them... Besides, you must have a reason why you absolutely cannot lose, don't you?
rows.notes: Them is comrades; prompts personal reason following earlier Linda scene.

rows.en: Huh...
rows.notes: Surprised response to George's prompt.

rows.en: For the comrades waiting for us... For the world we must protect...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished list completed by151; restores relational us/we.
uncertain: Retains the deliberate list fragment across rows150-151; its governing clause appears in151.

rows.en: And for that single, lovely flower who believes in us... We must win...
rows.notes: Chivalric metaphor prompts Kaine to name Linda at152; George speaks inclusively of their loved ones.

rows.en: Linda...
rows.notes: Identifies Kaine's flower and personal reason.

rows.en: That is my code of chivalry. If you're a descendant of samurai, show me your warrior's code.
rows.notes: Knighthood contrasted with Kaine's Japanese samurai ancestry; bushido rendered warrior's code.

rows.en: Heh... Now I finally get it... Why you were chosen to be my teacher...
rows.notes: Kaine understands George's appointment; passive keeps appointing authority unspecified.
uncertain: Retains omission of the appointing party in a passive; source does not identify who assigned George as teacher.

rows.en: You won't need a death poem, will you? Then here I come...!
rows.notes: George's samurai death-poem reference follows bushido challenge.

rows.en: Yeah! I'll settle this with this next strike!!
rows.notes: Kaine commits to succeeding in next lethal training exchange.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!

rows.en: That's more than we've ever seen in a first wave...!
rows.notes: Compares opening attack strength with previous attacks.

rows.en: Could those guys... be planning to settle things here and now!?
rows.notes: Bridge reaction to the unusually large enemy force; restores the enemy as subject.

rows.en: All hands, prepare to intercept!
rows.notes: Orders his crew to prepare for the enemy attack.

rows.en: Heh heh heh. We've known each other a long time, but it sure went by fast...
rows.notes: Taunts the allied force; contrasts apparently long acquaintance with its brevity.

rows.en: Today's the last time I'll ever see your faces, #部隊名!
rows.notes: Addresses the squad directly; runtime squad name preserved.

rows.en: I-I-I'll kill you dead!!
rows.notes: Stuttering emphatic death threat; keeps the violent force of the line.

rows.en: Gol, our job is to buy time until the colonel gets here. Don't go charging ahead without thinking!
rows.notes: Restrains Gol; colonel refers to Gon Jem.

rows.en: U-uhhh... M-mmm...!!
rows.notes: Frustrated inarticulate response to Ganan; vocalization retained.

rows.en: Man... I almost admire how those guys just won't let go.
rows.notes: Comments on the enemy squad's persistent grudge.

rows.en: Yeah, even though their homeland on the Moon is in chaos.
rows.notes: Answers Tapp; homeland is the enemy's lunar base. Restores the clause's subject and verb after semantic self-review.

rows.en: But that may be exactly why they've resolved never to retreat. We mustn't let our guard down.
rows.notes: Warns the allied pilots; enemy resolve may result from the lunar upheaval.

rows.en: Those guys don't seem too big on patriotism... but you've got a point.
rows.notes: Acknowledges Duke's warning despite doubting the enemy's patriotism.

rows.en: More to the point, I can't see Gon Jem's machine anywhere.
rows.notes: Redirects attention to the missing enemy commander.

rows.en: Y-you're right...
rows.notes: Confirms Tetsuya's observation.

rows.en: Maybe he still hasn't learned his lesson and plans to ambush us again?
rows.notes: Suggests Gon Jem intends another surprise attack; restores he/us.

rows.en: Then George's prediction was right.
rows.notes: Connects the missing commander to George's earlier assessment.

rows.en: ...I just hope Kaine can make it in time.
rows.notes: Kaine remains in training with George while his friends cover him.

rows.en: Yeah. Even his usual knack for winging it won't get him through this one...
rows.notes: Kaine's improvisation will not substitute for completing his training.

rows.en: There's no need to worry. George should be able to guide him properly.
rows.notes: Reassures Tapp and Light about George's instruction of Kaine.

rows.en: Yes. And Kaine has the talent. Now it's just a matter of time.
rows.notes: Adds confidence in Kaine's aptitude.

rows.en: Then let's leave the rest to fate and take these guys on!
rows.notes: Uses the leave-it-to-heaven sense of unten; Tapp and Light cover Kaine.

rows.en: Yeah!
rows.notes: Agrees to fight alongside Tapp.

rows.en: ...So you're coming, #部隊名!
rows.notes: Taunts the advancing squad; placeholder preserved.

rows.en: G-G-Ganan! D-D-D-1 ain't here!
rows.notes: Notices Kaine's Dragonar-1 is missing; preserves stutter and D-1 designation.

rows.en: Heh heh heh. Looks like he got scared of the colonel's broadsword and went into hiding.
rows.notes: Mocks absent Kaine; colonel is Gon Jem and weapon is his Chinese broadsword.

rows.en: Well, I don't care if he's here or not! Boys, get 'em!
rows.notes: Orders his men to attack whether Kaine is present or absent.

rows.en: I... I'll do it... Next time I see 'em, I'll... I'll smash 'em... Ugh...
rows.notes: Defeat-event dying vow. His speech deliberately trails off; no completed promise added.

rows.en: G-Gol!! Y-you idiot... You just couldn't wait for the colonel to get here...
rows.notes: Reaction to Gol's defeat; addresses Gol, condemning his premature attack.

rows.en: But I'll avenge you...!
rows.notes: Promises vengeance for Gol; restores speaker as avenger.

rows.en: H-help meee!! Gaaah!!

rows.en: G-Ganan!!

rows.en: Y-you've gotta be kidding!! Me!! How could this happen to meeee!?

rows.en: Z-Zin!!
rows.notes: Reacts to Zin's defeat; name-only cry retained.

rows.en: Ooooh, Zin!! Zin!!!
rows.notes: Mourns Zin's defeat; vocative cry retained. Keeps canonical name spelling even in a prolonged shout.

rows.en: Raaaaaagh!!
rows.notes: Wordless rage at his subordinate's defeat.

rows.en: I'll never forgive you now!! I'll kill you for sure!!
rows.notes: Threatens the allies after Zin's defeat; restores both subjects and target.

rows.en: Grrr!! I couldn't even avenge Gol, Ganan and the others!!
rows.notes: Min's defeat reaction; others retained rather than limiting the fallen to two people.

rows.en: I-I have to eject!!
rows.notes: Min attempts escape from her defeated machine; restores self-directed action.

rows.en: M-Min!!
rows.notes: Alternative defeat reaction if Zin survives Min; vocative cry retained.

rows.en: D-damn you!! Raaaaaagh!!!
rows.notes: Rage at Min's defeat directed at the allies.

rows.en: I'll never forgive you bastards! I'll cut you to shreds!!
rows.notes: Full violent threat retained.

rows.en: C-come out, D-1!! Fight meeee!!
rows.notes: Combat exchange against the ship: demands Kaine's machine come out.

rows.notes: Bridge report identifying the ship as target.

rows.en: What?!
rows.notes: Spoken scene response; settled subject/action restored where needed.

rows.en: A-aaah!!
rows.notes: Alarmed cry after Bright's shared-source What reaction.

rows.en: Lay down a barrage and take evasive action, now!!
rows.notes: Orders simultaneous covering fire and evasion.

rows.en: I don't want you!! Bring out D-1! Bring out the Dragonar!!
rows.notes: Rejects Tapp or the ship as target; specifically wants Kaine's D-1.

rows.en: What the hell are you talking about? My machine's a Dragonar too!!
rows.notes: Tapp objects that Dragonar-2 is also a Dragonar.

rows.en: Move! Move!! I don't want some Dragonar pancake!!
rows.notes: Adapts dorayaki pun as Dragonar pancake; dismisses the other Dragonars as food rather than his desired opponent.
uncertain: Dorayaki/Dragonar wordplay adapted to Dragonar pancake; exact Japanese sound pun cannot carry into English.

rows.en: A D-Dragonar pancake!? You've got some nerve calling us that!
rows.notes: Repeats the adapted food insult from 207 and objects.

rows.en: It's a tired old line, but today's the day you die, Dragonar!!
rows.notes: Acknowledges his death threat is a stock line.

rows.en: Then here's a tired old line from me! "I'll turn the tables and take you down!"
rows.notes: Returns Ganan's stock-threat joke; kaeriuchi means defeating the attacker.

rows.en: Hyah hah hah! I'm sick of that big ugly mug of yours! Go straight to hell!!
rows.notes: Taunts Light/Dragonar-3's large face; afterlife threat rendered with matching hostility.

rows.en: Sorry, but the Moon's as far as I'm willing to go!!
rows.notes: Answers the afterlife threat with a travel joke; speaker's destination restored.

rows.en: Here I come, Gon Jem! I'll turn that ridiculously huge Metal Armor into your coffin!
rows.notes: Direct combat taunt to Gon Jem; exact glossary Metal Armor retained.

rows.en: I can't lose... I can't lose! I can't lose until I've avenged those dear boys of mine!
rows.notes: Loves his fallen subordinates; affectionate wording retained rather than generic revenge.

rows.en: Die! Die! Dragonar!! You must die!!
rows.notes: Repetitive berserk death demand.

rows.en: Damn... If that's how you want it, I'll settle this right here!!
rows.notes: Answers Gon Jem's challenge; restores speaker's intention.

rows.en: Dragonars! You... You of all people... I'll kill you with my own hands!!
rows.notes: Restores the killing verb elided in his threat; plural address preserved.

rows.en: H-he's so fierce... He's like an ogre or a demon!!
rows.notes: Describes Gon Jem's overpowering fighting spirit, not a Spirit Command.

rows.en: Where are you, Dragonar!! I... I'll cut you in two!!
rows.notes: Seeks Light's Dragonar; restores target and speaker in threat.

rows.en: Urgh... Halfhearted attacks won't stop this guy!
rows.notes: Warns that stopping berserk Gon Jem requires committed attacks.

rows.en: This man's pursuit of power has destroyed his mind...
rows.notes: Reflects on Gon Jem's self-destruction; mind is the victim, not merely morale.

rows.en: I'll finish this in one blow, so at least he won't suffer...!
rows.notes: Duke intends a merciful swift defeat; restores both actor and beneficiary.

rows.en: Damn it! They weren't kidding about giving a... you-know-what a blade!

rows.en: Now we've got no choice but to hold him down by force!!
rows.notes: Plans to subdue Gon Jem; restores allied actor and enemy target.

rows.en: Damn... Gon Jem's fighting instincts have gone completely out of control...! This'll be trouble!
rows.notes: The pilot's instincts are running wild, not just the machine.

rows.notes: Explicitly contrasts pilot and machine; sourced male identity from glossary.

rows.en: You're a pitiful man, Gon Jem...
rows.notes: Solemn pity directed at Gon Jem; restores copula and addressed subject.

rows.en: I'll grant you this last mercy... My fists will shatter your obsession!!
rows.notes: Mercy is Domon's intent; deluded obsession belongs to Gon Jem.

rows.en: Th-this man... He's just like an EVA that's gone berserk...!
rows.notes: Compares Gon Jem's condition to an EVA's berserk state.

rows.en: I'll stop him... I have to! Even if he's our enemy, we can't just leave him like this!!
rows.notes: Feels responsible for stopping the enemy's suffering; all implied actors restored.

rows.en: Urgh... I can feel the pilot's obsession reaching me all the way through that machine...!
rows.notes: Ayato senses Gon Jem's obsession through the enemy unit.

rows.en: At this rate, he'll take us down before he destroys himself...!
rows.notes: Warns that allies will fall before Gon Jem self-destructs.

rows.en: If we let misplaced sympathy hold us back, we'll be the ones who lose...!
rows.notes: Warns allies against inadequate resolve; restores both allied subjects.

Hmph! So you're here!!
You sure took your time!
Did you find a surefire way to win!?
Just leave it to meee!!

How's that! I've seen through your Azure Dragon Sword!!

Kaine...!!
Did you see that, Linda? I'm not scared of that bastard anymore! I'll protect you, I promise!!

rows.en: Thank you, Kaine...!
Whew! Kaine really pulled it off!!
Yes, that was splendid!
Heheh, well, I had one hell of a teacher!
When did you learn a move like that, boy!? D-don't tell me!?

rows.en: So it wasn't a fluke! You Gon Jem bastard!!

rows.en: You cheeky little shit! I'll kill you first!!
Come and get me! I'll break that sword in two!!

I'm just getting started! Gwahahahaha!!
Ugh!! Guaaah!!
What's wrong with him!?
Uaaaah!! Die! Diiie!! You bastaaards!!

Colonel...! Zin, stop him!!
Got it!
Colonel! What's happened to you!?

Colonel! What's gotten into you!?

!? N-no way...!! Colonel, why are you attacking me!?

Guh! I've got to eject!!

rows.en: He cut down his own ally...!?
Th-that's brutal... You can't do this... Colonel...!!
What the hell happened to him!?
Miku, can't you figure out what's wrong!?
The machine's control system is probably putting pressure on the pilot's mind!
Th-that sounds... like the Berserker System...!
What!?
Maybe that Metal Armor has a thought-control system...

rows.en: ...installed in it...!

uncertain: Retained a deliberate source fragment or nonverbal reaction; see notes.

rows.en: I see. No wonder it moves so well.
But those systems strain both machine and body... He'll destroy himself even if we leave him alone.

rows.en: No, we can't underestimate how persistent Gon Jem is!
If we don't settle this once and for all here, he'll chase us to the ends of the earth!!
That's right! A system like that should never exist!
Graaah!! Where are you!? Where are you, you brat!?
I'll kill you! I'll fucking kill you!!
Gon Jem! I'm going to stop you myself!!
W-why!? How could I lose to a bunch of brats like them!?

rows.en: I won't die!! I won't die until I've fucking killed you all!! Uwaaaah!!
I-I beat him... I beat him...!
Th-the colonel's been defeated!! Retreat! Retreeeat!!
The enemy signals have disappeared!
Good... Recover all our machines.
So that's the end of the Gon Jem Squad...
Still, those Giganos bastards built one hell of a Metal Armor...
We'd be in big trouble if they ever mass-produced those.
The Hyakki Empire or the Vegan Empire might do that... but surely Giganos wouldn't?
You never know. Giganos seems to have plenty of people who think that way.
They might crank them out, then come charging at us!
Th-that might happen...
But, Kaine... You saved me.
No, you should thank George, my teacher.

rows.en: No, you had the potential all along... the potential of a samurai.
And it seems the princesse's presence played a large part, too.

I see...

uncertain: Retained a deliberate source fragment or nonverbal reaction; see notes.

rows.en: Hey, hey, what's a princesse?

rows.en: It's French for princess.
rows.notes: Whispered reply explaining the French word.

Question mark only is deliberate nonverbal confusion.
uncertain: Retained a deliberate source fragment or nonverbal reaction; see notes.

rows.notes: Addresses Asuka and Rose, who are whispering.

rows.en: If we tell him, it'll just go to his head...
rows.notes: Asuka tells Rose that telling Kaine would inflate his ego; deliberate trailing explanation.

rows.en: Yes, let's keep it to ourselves.

uncertain: Technical term rendered literally; no exact entry in the supplied glossary.

We're back, Spiral Castle!!
Where's Lagowe...!? Where is it!?
...So you've come, Dendoh... and you humans.
Do those fools intend to attack this castle with so few troops again?
Hmph. They really do underestimate us.
Have they lost all hope after losing two Data Weapons?
Either way, it's convenient that they've come to us...
Defeat Dendoh and obtain the remaining Data Weapons.
Yes, sir!
And... Whatever you do, don't let Lagowe outside.
If it goes after Dendoh and gets hurt fighting it... I could never face His Majesty the Emperor.

rows.en: Understood.
Enemy Machine Beasts have appeared!
Heh, look at them all! They've got some nerve!
rows.notes: Ryoko reacts to swarm of approaching enemies; colloquial irritation.

rows.en: Lieutenant, didn't you say something like that earlier, too?
rows.notes: Responds to shared route row all-source541, Ryoko remark about the enemy crowd.

rows.en: Huh? Who gives a damn about that!?
More importantly, where's Lagowe!? Where is it!?
I still can't see it... Could it be inside Spiral Castle?
rows.notes: Hokuto cannot find Lagowe, so its presence inside the castle is conjecture.

rows.en: ...That Lagowe isn't a new addition to Spiral Castle's forces.
rows.notes: Vega explains Lagowe is not an ordinary castle reinforcement.

rows.en: They probably can't control it themselves...
Yes, we can safely assume it's being held inside the castle.
Then we'll have to lure it out of Spiral Castle...!
Yes. Then Dendoh will act as bait and lead Lagowe to the capture point...
rows.notes: Vega gives allied pilots the trap plan; deliberately continues into399.

rows.en: We'll stop it with the super-electromagnetic net deployed there, then collect its data.
rows.notes: Allied forces immobilize Lagowe and sample its data.
uncertain: Technical term rendered literally; no exact entry in the supplied glossary.

rows.en: Yeah, I know!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga confirms Vega's capture plan. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: But don't forget this. Once you get Lagowe out of the castle...
rows.notes: Context: Vega warns both boys; deliberate sentence continuation. Decision: Vega addresses both Dendoh pilots; sentence deliberately carries into row402.

rows.en: Whatever else comes out, lure it straight to the capture point.
rows.notes: Context: Vega instructs both boys to prioritize Lagowe. Decision: Object is Lagowe; other emerging enemies must not distract the pilots.

rows.en: We aren't here for a final showdown with Spiral Castle...!
rows.notes: Context: Vega clarifies mission scope, urgently. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Don't worry!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga reassures Vega; imperative has clear listener. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: We understand!
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto confirms the warning. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: All right... First, we'll take out the enemy units and shake up Spiral Castle!
rows.notes: Context: Amuro commands allied units to provoke the castle. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Roger!
Then let's go! I call it "Operation Catch Lagowe!"!!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga enthusiastically names the operation. Decision: First of three improvised operation names, increasingly silly.

rows.en: Huh?! What's that supposed to be?
rows.notes: Context: Elle questions Ginga's awkward name. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Come up with an operation name with a little more flair!
rows.notes: Context: Drill asks Ginga to invent a better name. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Th-then... "Operation Come Here, Lagowe"!!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga stutters into a second attempt. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Hmm... That doesn't sound very tense.
rows.notes: Context: Roux critiques the name's lack of tension. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: More like, it's just weird.
rows.notes: Context: Ple calls the name weird; colloquial correction. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Aaagh, enough! Quit nitpicking! Then how about "Operation Go, Dendoh! Blow Gulfer Away"?!!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga snaps at the critics and offers the concert-title name. Decision: Concert-title joke; same title retained verbatim at row429.
uncertain: Improvised title translated as a spoken joke; no independently established English concert title.

rows.en: Th-that's so corny!
rows.notes: Context: Elle calls Ginga's latest name corny. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: ...Isn't that the name of C-DRiVE's first concert?
rows.notes: Context: Kamille identifies the borrowed title. Decision: Kamille recognizes the concert title, provoking teasing.

rows.en: C-DRiVE?
rows.notes: Context: Male lead asks about the group; name-only echo retained. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: They're a popular three-girl idol group. Haven't you heard of them?
rows.notes: Context: Female lead explains C-DRiVE to the male lead. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: No, I haven't.
rows.notes: Context: Male lead says he does not know them. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: You really don't keep up with that sort of thing, do you?
rows.notes: Context: Female lead teases male lead's ignorance of pop culture. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Oh! Kamille, are you a C-DRiVE fan too?!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga asks Kamille whether he too is a fan. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: No, it's not really like that...
rows.notes: Context: Kamille denies being a fan, trailing off. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: We're about to start an operation! This is no time to talk about...
rows.notes: Context: Vega scolds the chatting allies; Ruri interrupts. Decision: Vega scolds the pilots; deliberately interrupted by Ruri.

rows.en: ...I don't see any harm in it.
rows.notes: Context: Ruri calmly defends the banter to Vega. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Huh?
rows.notes: Context: Vega reacts to Ruri; interjection retained. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: It's better than being all tense. This operation will be tough in all sorts of ways.
rows.notes: Context: Ruri contrasts banter with harmful tension. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Besides... Guys who can crack jokes at a time like this are pretty dependable, you know?
rows.notes: Context: Ryoko endorses fighters who can joke before danger. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: My old buddies were just like that, too.
rows.notes: Context: Ryoko recalls her old companions. Decision: Ryoko refers to her former Nadesico companions.

rows.en: You're right. It may be better than getting all gloomy...
rows.notes: Context: Vega accepts the argument against gloomy thinking. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Well then, everyone... "Operation Go, Dendoh! Blow Gulfer Away" is now underway.
rows.notes: Context: Ruri announces the same humorously named operation. Decision: Ruri dryly adopts Ginga's concert title as the operation name.
uncertain: Uses the same translated concert title as row413.

rows.en: All riiight! Here we gooo!!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga cheers and launches into action. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Hang in there, Unicorn, Leo! We'll bring back Lagowe's data for sure!
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto promises Unicorn and Leo that they will get the data. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Ginga, we've got to get this thing to the capture point somehow!
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto directs Ginga to lure Lagowe to the capture point. Decision: Hokuto tells Ginga to lure Lagowe rather than grapple.

rows.en: Don't get careless and try to grapple with it!
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto warns Ginga against careless grappling. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Yeah, I know!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga acknowledges Hokuto's warning. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Hang in there, Leo!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga directly reassures Leo. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Unicorn! We'll beat this thing and save you and the others! I promise!!
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto directly promises Unicorn rescue for the Data Weapons. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: I'll teach you once again how utterly useless justice is, Rom!!
rows.notes: Context: Bug taunts Rom about justice's uselessness. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Ridiculous! Go back where you belong, Bug Newman!
rows.notes: Context: Rom dismisses Bug and orders him back where he belongs. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Oh, right, right. Before we fight, I'll give ya a useful tip.
rows.notes: Context: Devil Saturn 6 offers an enemy/player a battle tip. Decision: Devil Saturn 6 uses coarse colloquial speech for Kansai dialect.

rows.en: If ya want money, ya'd better take us on before Lagowe.
rows.notes: Context: Devil Saturn 6 advises fighting him first for money. Decision: Money refers to game rewards; enemy invites player to fight him first.

rows.en: We don't owe that giant pointy thing a damn thing anymore...
rows.notes: Context: Devil Saturn 6 dismisses obligations to Spiral Castle. Decision: Giant pointy thing is mocking reference to Spiral Castle.
uncertain: Mocking nickname inferred as Spiral Castle from rows380-388.

rows.en: Once we send ya to hell, we're headin' straight home!
rows.notes: Context: Devil Saturn 6 threatens enemies with hell before leaving. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: What's with you?! You're buddying up with the Earthlings after all!
rows.notes: Context: Devil Saturn 6 mocks Rom's alliance with Earthlings. Decision: Devil Saturn 6 addresses Rom; reply445-446 rejects opportunistic alliances.

rows.en: Ya really have no principles at all!
rows.notes: Context: Devil Saturn 6 accuses Rom of having no principles. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: The bonds of evil last only as long as they serve each other's interests...
rows.notes: Context: Rom defines evil alliances as temporary mutual gain. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: But those who strive for justice are always united in spirit, even if they were born on different planets!
rows.notes: Context: Rom contrasts justice's shared purpose across planets. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: We don't have time to fight the likes of you!
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto dismisses Devil Saturn 6 as a distraction. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Big talk from a brat! Ignore your elders and I'll make ya regret it!
rows.notes: Context: Devil Saturn 6 insults Hokuto as a brat and threatens him. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Shut up! We've got no business with you!!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga tells Devil Saturn 6 to shut up and dismisses him. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: I did a little research on ya! You're quite the ladies' man!
rows.notes: Context: Devil Saturn 6 taunts Kazuya as a ladies' man. Decision: Devil Saturn 6 taunts Kazuya; row452 is Kazuya's answer.

rows.en: But guys like you, actin' all cool, make our skin crawl!
rows.notes: Context: Devil Saturn 6 expresses revulsion at Kazuya's cool looks. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: What a coincidence! When I see crooks like you, I get fired up to fight!
rows.notes: Context: Kazuya counters that villains stir his fighting spirit. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Bug Newman! You've forgotten Master Kirai's teachings, and I'll strike you down!
rows.notes: Context: Jet vows to defeat Bug for betraying Kirai's teachings. Decision: Jet addresses Bug, the renegade disciple; Master Kirai is Kirai Stol.

rows.en: Heh... To me, you're still the same little boy you were back then!
rows.notes: Context: Bug belittles Jet as the same childhood weakling. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: You bastard! I'll never forgive you for using Tenku Chushin Ken for evil!
rows.notes: Context: Drill condemns Bug's evil use of Tenku Chushin Ken. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Hmph... You've grown bigger, but your brain's still a kid's!
rows.notes: Context: Bug belittles Drill's intelligence despite his size. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Oh... Leina's here too? Then I'd better go say hello to her as well!
rows.notes: Context: Bug threatens Leina Stol under the guise of greeting her. Decision: Leina is Rom's sister here, not Judau's sister.

rows.en: I won't let you! As long as I'm here, you won't lay a finger on the young lady!
rows.notes: Context: Jim vows to protect Leina Stol from Bug. Decision: Jim protects Leina Stol.

rows.en: Bug Newman! You disgrace Tenku Chushin Ken! I'll strike you down in my father's place!
rows.notes: Context: Leina Stol challenges Bug on behalf of her father. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Then answer me this! What has the justice preached by Tenku Chushin Ken ever given me?!
rows.notes: Context: Bug demands what the school's justice has given him. Decision: Bug attacks the value of Kirai's doctrine of justice.

rows.en: Well, that's...
rows.notes: Context: Leina's reply trails off; deliberate incomplete answer retained. Decision: Leina's deliberate unfinished response.

rows.en: I use my power for myself! I'll show no mercy to anyone who tries to stop me, whoever they are!
rows.notes: Context: Bug asserts selfish power and threatens anyone opposing him. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: This man... He uses Tenku Chushin Ken?!
rows.notes: Context: Kazuya recognizes Bug's martial-arts school. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: That's right! Can you dodge my invincible fists?!
rows.notes: Context: Bug boasts of his invincible fists to Kazuya. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Fists steeped in evil won't work against me and Daimos!
rows.notes: Context: Kazuya rejects evil fists against himself and Daimos. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Th-this guy's moves...!
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto begins recognizing Bug's style, trailing off. Decision: Hokuto trails off in recognition; Ginga completes the identification467.

rows.en: He's using Tenku Chushin Ken, just like Rom!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga supplies the recognized school shared with Rom. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: That's right! I am Bug Newman, the greatest master of Tenku Chushin Ken in the universe!
rows.notes: Context: Bug boasts he is the universe's best master. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Newman? ...Are you related to Light, by any chance?
rows.notes: Context: Hokuto jokes about Bug and Light sharing Newman. Decision: Newman surname joke refers to Dragonar pilot Light Newman.

rows.en: Does being called Bug mean you're a Machine Beast?
rows.notes: Context: Ginga jokes Bug's name sounds like a Machine Beast. Decision: Bug name joke evokes Gulfer Machine Beasts.

rows.en: You're talking nonsense! I'll shut that smart mouth of yours forever with my fists!
rows.notes: Context: Bug threatens to silence the boys permanently. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Like hell you will! If I lose to a crook's martial arts, Mom will chew me out!
rows.notes: Context: Ginga refuses defeat and jokes about his mother's scolding. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: This beast's power and speed... Can we really hold it down...?!
rows.notes: Context: Amuro doubts their ability to restrain Lagowe. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Don't give up, Ginga, Hokuto! We'll hold it down together and get that vaccine, no matter what!
rows.notes: Context: Kamille urges Ginga and Hokuto to persist and obtain the vaccine. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Leina, I'm counting on you to look after Leo and the others! We'll bring back the vaccine for sure!!
rows.notes: Context: Judau asks Leina Ashta to care for Leo and the others. Decision: Judau asks his sister Leina Ashta to care for the Data Weapons, not offering to do so.

rows.en: Some men have fought bears and water buffalo with karate...! I'll hold this thing down myself!!
rows.notes: Context: Kazuya uses the karate-versus-animals precedent as motivation. Decision: Preserves bears and water buffalo; martial-arts anecdote without adding a name.

rows.en: Beast of destruction and slaughter! My fists will strike you down and save our comrades' friends!
rows.notes: Context: Rom vows to defeat Lagowe and save his comrades' friends. Decision: Our comrades' friends are the Data Weapons.

rows.en: I'll hold this thing down, no matter what!
rows.notes: Context: Male lead vows to restrain Lagowe at any cost. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Yes! I'm going in at full power!!
rows.notes: Context: Female lead agrees and commits full power. Decision: Use natural spoken English; restore settled subjects and verbs, retaining the source tone.

rows.en: Incoming message from GEAR HQ! They say the Lagowe virus has started spreading faster again!
rows.notes: Hari relays HQ warning; virus, not Lagowe itself, is advancing.

rows.en: What did you say!?
Everyone, please hurry! At this rate, the Data Weapons will...!!
rows.notes: Deliberate alarm trails off before stating the Data Weapons' fate.
uncertain: Retained deliberately unstated consequence for the Data Weapons.

rows.en: Daaamn it!! Come on out already, Lagowe!!
Then we have no choice but to attack Spiral Castle directly!
Wait, both of you! Have you forgotten what Vega said?!

rows.notes: Hokuto's nonverbal surprise retained.

rows.en: Spiral Castle isn't our target... Lagowe is. What good will it do to get worked up and lose sight of what you have to do?
rows.notes: Kamille addresses both boys; Lagowe is the objective, not the castle.

rows.en: T-that's right...! If we can't get Lagowe's data, it'll all be pointless...!
But we're just wasting time like this!!
It'll show up. It has to...! It should react to this battle we're fighting!
rows.notes: It refers to Lagowe; this battle refers to the allied battle around Spiral Castle.

rows.en: Hmm...!
Oyakata-sama, what's happening...?!
rows.notes: Fixed Oyakata-sama title preserved.

rows.en: Lagowe... Lagowe is running wild!
What did you say?!

uncertain: Silence retained for both uses.

rows.notes: Nonverbal punctuation preserved for both original appearances.
Nonverbal punctuation preserved for both original appearances.

rows.en: What's wrong with you two?!
rows.notes: Ginga addresses the Data Weapons, not Hokuto and Ple Two.

rows.en: C-could it be...?!
rows.notes: Deliberate incomplete realization answered by Ple Two.
uncertain: Retained incomplete realization; no omitted recoverable ordinary subject.

rows.en: Hokuto, Ginga! That thing's coming out!
rows.notes: That thing refers to Lagowe.
Ginga reacts without words; both uses read in context.

rows.en: There it is!!
There it is!!
So the real target finally showed its ugly face...!
Yes, now the real battle begins!
Hokuto, Ginga, please lure Lagowe to the capture point.
rows.notes: Ruri requests the boys lure Lagowe, not destroy it.

rows.en: Right! Ginga, recall the Data Weapons!
rows.notes: Hokuto tells Ginga to recall the Data Weapons.

rows.en: Yeah! We can't let Lagowe get Boar and Dragon, too!
rows.notes: Source-short Boar and Dragon remain short; they mean Gatling Boar and Dragon Flare.

rows.en: Return, Dragon!
Return, Boar!
Hokuto, Ginga... You know where the capture point is, right?
Yes, it's over there!
Lure it over to that point. And everyone else, don't attack Lagowe.
rows.notes: Amuro instructs Hokuto and Ginga, then all other allies.

rows.en: If you shoot it down, we won't be able to get its data.
rows.notes: Defeating Lagowe prevents the data collection required for the vaccine.

rows.en: Roger!
rows.notes: Kamille acknowledges the order; conventional response retained.

rows.en: Come on, follow me! Lagowe!!
1. Get Lagowe to the capture point
rows.notes: Plain victory condition; explicit numbered line preserved.

rows.en: 1. Lagowe is shot down@2. GEAR Fighter Dendoh or Rom is shot down@3. An allied mothership is shot down
rows.notes: Three plain defeat-condition lines; either Dendoh or Rom losing triggers defeat.

rows.en: Oyakata-sama... As we thought, Lagowe is following Dendoh.
rows.notes: Giga Absolute reports to Spiral Castle.

rows.en: This is bad. If things go wrong, even the two remaining Data Weapons will fall prey to Lagowe.
rows.notes: Remaining two Data Weapons are Dragon Flare and Gatling Boar; no names added.

rows.en: Stop Lagowe. It must not be allowed to fight.
Lagowe has entered the capture point!
Then please snare it in the super electromagnetic net.
rows.notes: Ruri asks Hari to deploy the capture net; source reply at s06s20:362 confirms.

rows.en: Yes, ma'am!
rows.notes: Hari accepts Ruri's order.

rows.en: All right, we've caught it!!
Oyakata-sama, Lagowe is...!
rows.notes: Giga Gourmet trails off while reporting the capture.
uncertain: Retained trailing report, with consequence visible in preceding capture event.

rows.en: Hmph...!
Now all we need to do is collect Lagowe's data!
rows.notes: Vega states the final required task; interruption follows at 524.

rows.en: Hold it right there!!
rows.notes: Hidden speaker preserved as ??? until source reveal.

rows.en: Who's there?!
Where there is light, there is darkness. Where there is justice, there is evil.
rows.notes: Devil Saturn 6 parodies Rom's customary entrance.

rows.en: An envoy from hell, Devil Saturn 6! And here I aaaam!
rows.notes: Showy entrance call and elongation retained; natural comic English rather than invented geographic dialect.

rows.en: D-Devil Saturn 6...! At a time like this!
You! What do you think you're doing, copying my brother Rom?!
rows.notes: Leina explicitly calls Rom her brother.

rows.en: Hmm? Well, people get bored pretty fast when you always use the same routine.
It's fine to do something like this once in a while, isn't it?
If you're going to copy the original, I'd like at least one of his words of wisdom, too.
rows.notes: Saburota asks for the philosophical maxim associated with Rom's entrance.

rows.en: Saburota! This is no time for you to be saying things like that!!
You lot... What have you come here for?
rows.notes: Spiral Castle addresses the arriving Gyandlar forces.

rows.en: To say hello to our new neighbors... Just kidding. I came because I've got a little question for those folks.
rows.notes: Greeting to new neighbors is a moving-house joke; those folks means the allied cast.

rows.en: You've got a question for us?!
That's right. How about you tell me where the Meteo Cube is?
...Do you really think we'll just tell you?
Can't be helped. Then we'll do it by force... Hey, it's your turn!
rows.notes: First clause answers Vega, then Devil Saturn 6 summons Bug.

rows.en: Heh heh heh heh...
You're... Bug Newman!
rows.notes: Bug Newman, the Machine Robo disciple, not Machine Knight Bug.

rows.en: That's right, Rom. The same old sermons about justice... Heh, that takes me back.
rows.notes: Bug recalls Rom's justice speeches.

rows.en: Hey, you've gotta be kidding! Rom already beat that guy, didn't he?!
rows.notes: Drill addresses companions, referring to Bug.

rows.en: Yes. Why has the man who disgraced Tenku Chushin Ken come back now...?
rows.notes: Jet refers to Bug disgracing their martial art.

rows.en: Tenku Chushin Ken?! Then he's...
rows.notes: Kazuya's unfinished inference is explained by Jet in 547-548.
uncertain: Retained unfinished inference continued by Jet.

rows.en: He was the greatest disciple of our teacher... Master Kirai, Rom and Leina's father...
rows.notes: Greatest disciple renders first/chief disciple; Master Kirai is their teacher and siblings' father.
uncertain: First disciple understood as chief/greatest disciple rather than explicit first enrollment; source and profile establish senior disciple.

rows.en: But he used Tenku Chushin Ken to commit evil deeds, and Rom defeated him.
rows.notes: Continuation of 547 with explicit Bug subject.

rows.en: Bug, have you returned from the depths of the earth, just like Devil Saturn 6 and Diondra?
rows.notes: Rom addresses Bug; retains returned from the earth imagery without deciding whether Devil Saturn actually died.

rows.en: Hey, hold on! Like I said before, I don't remember ever being beaten by the likes of you!
rows.notes: Devil Saturn rejects Rom's claim he was defeated.

rows.en: Don't lump me in with Bug, you moron!
rows.notes: Direct insult preserved at full force.

rows.en: What? Then, Bug... What happened to you?!
rows.notes: Rom redirects the resurrection question to Bug.

rows.en: Yes. I did lose my fight with you back then.
But Lord Grujios brought my soul and body back to life.
rows.notes: Lord Grujios is addressed with reverence by Bug; no gender assumption.

rows.en: So I can send you to the hell I saw, Rom!
rows.notes: Continuation explaining purpose of Bug's resurrection.

rows.en: You've not only abandoned justice and pride, you've become a Gyandlar to the very core!
rows.notes: Gyandlar affiliation is moral degradation, not species transformation.

rows.en: Then, Bug! In my father Kirai's place, I'll punish you once again in the name of heaven!!
rows.notes: Rom takes his father's place and promises heavenly punishment.

rows.en: Well, well! Things are really heating up! In that case, how about this?!
rows.notes: Devil Saturn interrupts the confrontation to act on Lagowe.

rows.en: Aaah!!
Lagowe...!!
rows.notes: Retained alarm; following Mondo row 561 explains Lagowe has escaped.
uncertain: Retained name-only alarm; following row561 supplies escape, not added early.

rows.notes: Nonverbal reaction both on escape405 and Kiba appearance514; retains punctuation-only source.

rows.en: L-Lagowe got away!!
rows.notes: Witnesses Lagowe breaking free.

rows.en: D-damn it!!
rows.notes: Vega realizes containment failed.

rows.en: Uwaaaah!!
rows.notes: Ginga screams.

rows.en: Aaaaaah!!
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: Hokuto! Ginga!!
rows.notes: Calls to boys after their screams in source408-409.

rows.en: D-damn that Lagowe!!
rows.notes: Angry response to attack.

rows.en: What incredible power!!
rows.notes: Reacts to Lagowe's strength; deliberate exclamation.

rows.en: N-no! I can't let you two out!
rows.notes: Addresses reacting Dragon Flare and Gatling Boar, not the infected Unicorn and Leo.

rows.en: We're up against Lagowe! If you two get taken out as well...!!
rows.notes: Warns Dragon Flare and Gatling Boar; preserves unfinished feared consequence.
uncertain: Retains deliberate unfinished consequence after if-clause.

rows.en: Harry, what's the situation at GEAR headquarters...?!
rows.notes: Addresses Hari source label but Harry prescribed body spelling; asks status.

rows.en: I-it's apparently starting to affect even Unicorn and Leo's physical forms!!
rows.notes: Virus threatens stored physical data-weapon forms at GEAR, not pilots.

rows.en: N-no way!!
rows.notes: Shock at report.

rows.en: Daaaaamn it! I'm not going down! Not here!!
rows.notes: Angry elongated shout and emphatic final locative retained.

rows.en: I promised! I said I'd bring back that data, no matter what!!
rows.notes: Recalls Hokuto's personal promise directly to Unicorn and Leo at all-source584/s06s20:268; rescue remains joint mission.

rows.en: And we've gotta stop the mass driver!
rows.notes: Adds mission objective.

rows.en: That's why we can't lose!!
rows.notes: Completes shared resolve.
Leo Circle reacts without words.
